meta.name: computer-use
meta.description: OS/window-level inspection and input in visible local app windows through `orca computer`: native apps, external browser windows (Chrome, Edge, Safari), and app webviews. Not for Orca's embedded browser (use `orca-cli`) or page-only automation (use Playwright or CDP).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作本地可见应用窗口,完成点击、输入与界面内容读取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让程序代替你在桌面应用窗口里手动点击和输入。
copy.tagline_en: Automate clicks, typing, and reading content inside visible local app windows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a program to click and type in desktop app windows for you.

howto.what: 它会先确定本次会话该用哪个 Orca 可执行文件(如 orca-dev、orca-ide),再加载与版本匹配的 computer-use 指南,然后据该指南检查可见的本地应用窗口并发送输入。
howto.when: 当你要在本机可见窗口里做 OS/窗口级检查或输入时,比如原生应用、Chrome 等外部浏览器窗口;Orca 内嵌浏览器和纯页面自动化不走这里。

say.text: 加载 computer-use 指南,告诉我怎么操作
say.note: 会先解析本会话的 Orca 可执行文件再取指南

say.text: 用 orca computer 看看当前 Chrome 窗口里有什么
say.note: 对可见窗口做检查,不碰内嵌浏览器

say.text: Orca 没在运行,先启动它再重试
say.note: 对应 ORCA open --json,然后重试

howto.what_en: It first resolves which Orca executable this session should use (such as orca-dev or orca-ide), loads the version-matched computer-use guide, then inspects visible local app windows and sends input per that guide.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need OS/window-level inspection or input in visible local windows, such as native apps or external browser windows like Chrome. Not for Orca's embedded browser or page-only automation.

say_en.text: Load the computer-use guide and tell me how to proceed
say_en.note: Resolves this session's Orca executable, then fetches the guide

say_en.text: Use orca computer to check what's in my current Chrome window
say_en.note: Inspects visible windows only, not the embedded browser

say_en.text: Orca isn't running; start it and retry
say_en.note: Corresponds to ORCA open --json, then retry
